# Workstation's tab-chrome receipts read the outgoing shell mid-swap

## Context

`WorkstationReclaimEmbodimentNL` › *Reset and Undo carry the same live pane across the window boundary…* has been quarantined since 2026-10-13 (accountable: me). It always fails at spec :200 ("the home strip projects a tab for the reclaimed item", `Expected: not null`). The poll just before it had already passed: holders `[main]`, the pane mounted in root, root DOM 1, popup DOM 0. Red on both attempts in `38427910487`/`115402110808`; healed on retry in three other runs. About 5 of 21 first attempts failed.

## The Problem

Reset commits `restorePerspective`, a `topology`-class change, so the root runs the staged reconcile. Retained tab containers move into the staged shell at `items[1]`, the swap flight runs, and only then does `host.remove(outgoing)` make the new shell `items[0]` (`src/dashboard/dock/projection/Reconciler.mjs` ~639–679, 883–925). During that window `getTabChromeIdentity` reads `dock-host.items[0]`, the outgoing shell, which has no tabs left, and returns `null` (`apps/workstation/view/Workspace.mjs` ~510–517). `getShellIdentity` (~322) reads the same slot. `Reconciler.liveShell(host, shellIndex)` exists for exactly this window, and `src/dashboard/dock/plugin/Maximize.mjs:354` already uses it.

The model and DOM are fine, and DockFlip is not involved: the read walks the App Worker component tree. The timing is inferred from code order, not witnessed.

## The Fix (product)

`getTabChromeIdentity` and `getShellIdentity` resolve the shell through `DockProjectionReconciler.liveShell(this.getReference('dock-host'), this.dockShellIndex)` (already imported). Keep the spec's single read at :200 as the regression witness, and remove the quarantine entry.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AC-1: Both readers resolve the live shell, so a read during the swap sees the incoming shell.
- [ ] AC-2: A unit arm reads both methods with a retiring outgoing shell at `items[0]` and the incoming at `items[1]`; it is red before the fix and green after.
- [ ] AC-3: The quarantine entry is gone, and the spec passes on every attempt across ≥ 5 hosted runs.

## Out of Scope

- The same single-read hazard in `WorkstationPopupReturnNL:113` and `WorkstationReopenedPopupReturnNL:66`: they read through these methods and are fixed by AC-1 without spec changes.
